summary: Candidate c7f5e45 makes exactly the two owner-approved changes and nothing else: it widens the legal-page single-column/TOC-hidden breakpoint from 480px to 600px (keeping the 480px-only nav-button hiding unchanged) to close the reported 500px overflow on /privacy and /terms, adds 500px to scripts/check_hybrid_ui.py's tested widths, and replaces the StripeWelcomePage 'You're a Pro now' activation/deferred-feature copy with neutral 'Check your plan in Account' wording while leaving both button labels, destinations, and billing logic untouched. The updated PR7 test correctly replaces only the old headline assertion and adds solid coverage for the copy, absence of deferred-feature claims (portfolio/SunScout 3D, matching D-125), and preserved primary/secondary navigation destinations - traced against StubState's actual rendering (h2 heading, aria-hidden icons) and confirms it should pass. No protected files, scoring, data, auth, or billing code were touched, and the diff is confined to the 6 files needed. The one gap is that none of this was verified by an actual gate run in this session (Vitest, production build, and the Playwright matrix all hit the same sandbox spawn-permission errors seen in prior accepted rounds of this same task chain); the builder disclosed this transparently rather than claiming a false pass, consistent with the precedent that got the parent candidate (809a658) accepted despite identical sandbox blockers.
